analysis: The supplied units are BASE text for docs/provider/cli-reference.md at lines 1302-2005. The changed hunks are in the earlier base range 1021-1025 (head 956-962 and 1028-1043) and are not visible here. The patch excerpt is truncated. The PR is documentation-only in this file; no code, config defaults, or enforcement logic changed in the supplied evidence. Documented changes seen in the patch: (1) a drain with no unfinished work and no coordinator connection waits up to 10 seconds and then completes without an acknowledgement; (2) shutdown waits up to 15 seconds per model unload and leaves a stuck native retirement to process exit; (3) doctor diagnostics report an enabled_models restart-needed delta. Relevant threat IDs: T-010 (cancellation and drain availability), T-029 (GPU occupancy), T-041 (prefix-cache, TB-007), A-018. Reviewed text covers the logout and unenroll semantics, add-on hold runtime files, the App Attest worker env passthrough, and SSD cache env variables; it matches the retained posture of T-041 (TTL, disk budget, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch, coordinator cache routing off by default) and T-053/TB-011. Nothing weakens a security control. Cross-file question for integration: whether the new drain-without-acknowledgement path and unload-timeout abandonment match the actual ServiceDrain and ProviderLoop.unloadAllModelsForShutdown code, and whether process exit reliably clears decrypted data (T-028). Those source files are not in this batch, so the contract is unverified. The truncated patch also leaves a small residual risk that unseen hunk text introduces something not examined.
